notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]10/18/2016
notes.notes:
Patch V 1.2 was released today.

PATCH NOTES
• Added high-res assets for UI. (Font, text, symbols.)

If you are still experiencing issues after the patch, or if the patch introduced new issue, please let us know on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/458730/discussions/1/361798516959964973/]the forums[/url]. 

Thank you for your patience and understanding.
